title: The Satavahana dynasty mainly ruled which region of ancient India?
description: Identify the principal region associated with Satavahana rule.
hint: Think of the Deccan region.
summary: The Satavahanas were a major dynasty of the Deccan.

title: Which city is generally regarded as an important early capital of the Satavahanas?
description: Identify the city associated with the early Satavahana capital.
hint: It was located in present-day Maharashtra.
summary: Pratishthana, or Paithan, was an important Satavahana capital.

title: What was Pratishthana known as in later times?
description: Identify the modern name of the ancient Satavahana center Pratishthana.
hint: It is a historic city in Maharashtra.
summary: Pratishthana is identified with modern Paithan.

title: 118. Which Tiger Reserve is located in Jharkhand?
hint: It was one of the original Project Tiger reserves.
summary: Palamau Tiger Reserve in Jharkhand was among the first reserves included under Project Tiger.

title: 119. Which Tiger Reserve is located in Arunachal Pradesh and is also one of India's largest protected areas?
hint: It is known for exceptional biodiversity and shares an international border.
summary: Namdapha Tiger Reserve is among India's largest protected areas and biodiversity hotspots.

title: 120. Which Tiger Reserve lies in the Western Ghats and is shared between Karnataka and Tamil Nadu through connected landscapes?
hint: It is part of the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve landscape.
summary: Bandipur Tiger Reserve forms a crucial part of the Nilgiri landscape connecting multiple protected areas.

title: 121. Which Tiger Reserve is located in Maharashtra and is often called the 'Tiger Capital of Maharashtra'?
hint: It is famous for high tiger sightings and lies in eastern Maharashtra.
summary: Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve is one of India's most successful tiger conservation landscapes.

title: 122. Which Tiger Reserve is located in Kerala and is famous for its artificial lake created by the Mullaperiyar Dam?
hint: It is one of the best places to observe elephants in South India.
summary: Periyar Tiger Reserve is known for its lake ecosystem and rich biodiversity.

title: 123. Which Tiger Reserve is situated in Odisha and is known for melanistic (pseudo-melanistic) tigers?
hint: It is also a biosphere reserve and national park.
summary: Similipal Tiger Reserve is famous for rare pseudo-melanistic tigers.

title: Which waterfall is officially recognized by Guinness World Records as the world's tallest?
description: Choose the correct answer.
hint: It is located in Venezuela.
summary: The correct answer is Angel Falls.

title: Angel Falls is located in which country?
description: Choose the correct answer.
hint: It is in South America.
summary: The correct answer is Venezuela.

title: Angel Falls drops from which tepui?
description: Choose the correct answer.
hint: The name begins with Auyán.
summary: The correct answer is Auyán-tepui.

title: Angel Falls is situated within which national park?
description: Choose the correct answer.
hint: The park is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
summary: The correct answer is Canaima National Park.

title: What is the longest uninterrupted drop of Angel Falls?
description: Choose the correct answer.
hint: It is a little over 800 metres.
summary: The longest single drop is 807 metres.

title: Tugela Falls is located in which country?
description: Choose the correct answer.
hint: It is in southern Africa.
summary: The correct answer is South Africa.

title: What is a Ramsar Site?
description: Identify the meaning of a Ramsar Site.
hint: It relates to internationally important wetlands.
summary: A Ramsar Site is a wetland designated as internationally important under the Convention on Wetlands.

title: The Ramsar Convention is primarily concerned with the conservation of what?
description: Identify the main subject of the Ramsar Convention.
hint: Think of lakes, marshes and other water ecosystems.
summary: The Ramsar Convention focuses on wetlands and their conservation and wise use.

title: What are phumdis associated with?
description: Identify the floating vegetation masses characteristic of a famous northeastern lake.
hint: They are especially associated with Loktak Lake.
summary: Phumdis are floating masses of vegetation, soil and organic matter found prominently in Loktak Lake.

title: Which Ramsar Site is located in Assam?
description: Identify Assam's well-known Ramsar wetland.
hint: It is near Guwahati.
summary: Deepor Beel is a Ramsar Site in Assam.

title: Which Ramsar Site is located near Guwahati?
description: Identify the wetland situated close to Assam's largest city.
hint: It is an important bird habitat.
summary: Deepor Beel is located near Guwahati.

title: Which Ramsar Site is located in Andhra Pradesh?
description: Identify the major lake designated under the Ramsar Convention in Andhra Pradesh.
hint: It is a large freshwater lake near the Krishna-Godavari region.
summary: Kolleru Lake is a Ramsar Site in Andhra Pradesh.

title: Which Ramsar Site became India's 101st Ramsar Site in 2026?
description: Identify the wetland designated in August 2026.
hint: It is a freshwater lake in Arunachal Pradesh.
summary: Glaw Lake became India's 101st Ramsar Site in August 2026.

title: In which state is Glaw Lake located?
description: Identify the state containing India's 101st Ramsar Site.
hint: It is in the northeastern Himalayan region.
summary: Glaw Lake is located in Arunachal Pradesh.

title: Which pass connects Assam with Tawang through Arunachal Pradesh?
hint: It is lower in altitude than Sela Pass.
summary: Bomdi La Pass connects Assam with Tawang via West Kameng.

title: Diphu Pass lies near the tri-junction of India, China and which country?
hint: Its capital is Naypyidaw.
summary: Diphu Pass lies near the tri-junction of India, China and Myanmar.

title: Which mountain pass is located in the Pir Panjal Range?
hint: It historically linked Jammu with the Kashmir Valley.
summary: Banihal Pass is located in the Pir Panjal Range.

title: Which pass is crossed by the Jawahar Tunnel?
hint: The tunnel improved year-round connectivity to the Kashmir Valley.
summary: The Jawahar Tunnel passes beneath Banihal Pass.

title: Which mountain pass separates the Kullu Valley from Lahaul Valley?
hint: The Atal Tunnel now bypasses it.
summary: Rohtang Pass separates Kullu Valley from Lahaul Valley.

title: Which type of ecosystem is mainly found around Lakshadweep islands?
hint: It supports marine biodiversity and protects coastlines.
summary: Coral reef ecosystems are the dominant marine ecosystems around Lakshadweep.

title: Lakshadweep was formed as a Union Territory in which year?
hint: It was separated from Madras State.
summary: Lakshadweep became a Union Territory in 1956 under the States Reorganisation Act.

title: Which is the largest inhabited island of Lakshadweep?
hint: It is also the administrative capital of Lakshadweep.
summary: Kavaratti is the largest inhabited island and administrative headquarters of Lakshadweep.

title: Lakshadweep is the smallest Union Territory of India in terms of:
hint: Consider geographical size.
summary: Lakshadweep is the smallest Union Territory of India by area.

title: Which state is known as the 'Apple State of India'?
hint: Shimla is located here.
summary: Himachal Pradesh is known as the Apple State of India.

title: Which state has the largest population of tribal people?
hint: It is located in central India.
summary: Madhya Pradesh has the largest tribal population in India.

title: Which Indian state is the leading producer of silk?
hint: Bengaluru is its capital.
summary: Karnataka is India's leading producer of silk.

title: Which Indian state is known as the 'Land of Festivals'?
hint: It is a northeastern state.
summary: Nagaland is popularly known as the Land of Festivals.

title: Which Indian state has the largest area under mangrove forests?
hint: It is located in eastern India.
summary: West Bengal has the largest mangrove forest area in India due to the Sundarbans.

title: Which state is the largest producer of bamboo in India?
hint: It is located in Northeast India.
summary: Assam is India's leading producer of bamboo.

title: Keoladeo National Park is especially famous for which category of animals?
hint: Many migratory species visit annually.
summary: Keoladeo is internationally recognized as a bird sanctuary.

title: Valley of Flowers National Park is located in which state?
hint: The state is known as Devbhoomi.
summary: Valley of Flowers is renowned for its alpine meadows and endemic flora.

title: Nanda Devi National Park and Valley of Flowers together form which UNESCO property?
hint: The name includes a famous Himalayan peak.
summary: The combined UNESCO site is called Nanda Devi and Valley of Flowers National Parks.

options.title: Nanda Devi and Valley of Flowers National Parks

title: Sundarbans National Park is famous for which animal?
hint: It is the national animal of India.
summary: The Sundarbans contain one of the largest populations of Royal Bengal Tigers.

title: Sundarbans is the world's largest ecosystem of which type?
hint: Trees here can tolerate saline water.
summary: The Sundarbans contain the world's largest mangrove forest.

title: Which was the last ruling dynasty of Vijayanagara?
description: Which dynasty was the fourth and final major ruling dynasty of Vijayanagara?
hint: It followed the Tuluva dynasty.
summary: The Aravidu dynasty was the last major ruling dynasty.

title: Who founded the Aravidu dynasty?
description: Who established the Aravidu dynasty after the Battle of Talikota?
hint: He was the younger brother of Aliya Rama Raya.
summary: Tirumala Deva Raya established the Aravidu dynasty.

title: Which monument at Hampi is famous for its stone chariot?
description: Which Vijayanagara monument contains the famous stone chariot at Hampi?
hint: It is dedicated to Lord Vishnu's form Vithoba/Vittala.
summary: The Vittala Temple at Hampi is famous for its stone chariot.

title: Which temple at Hampi is dedicated to Virupaksha?
description: Which famous temple complex at Hampi is dedicated to Lord Virupaksha?
hint: It is located near the Hampi Bazaar.
summary: The Virupaksha Temple is one of the most important temples at Hampi.

title: 82. Which case established that Parliament cannot alter the Basic Structure of the Constitution?
hint: The judgment was delivered by the largest constitutional bench in Indian history.
summary: The Kesavananda Bharati case established the Basic Structure Doctrine.

title: 83. Which Article deals with the amendment of the Constitution?
hint: This Article lays down the procedure for constitutional amendments.
summary: Article 368 specifies the procedure for amending the Constitution.

title: 84. Which constitutional body conducts elections to Parliament and State Legislatures?
hint: It is established under Article 324.
summary: The Election Commission of India supervises and conducts elections.

title: 85. Which writ commands a public authority to perform its legal duty?
hint: Its Latin meaning is 'we command'.
summary: Mandamus is issued to direct a public authority to perform its duty.

title: 426. Which Harappan site is famous for its dockyard?
hint: Located in present-day Gujarat and associated with maritime trade.
summary: Lothal is famous for its dockyard, which indicates overseas trade activities.

title: 427. In which present-day state is Lothal located?
hint: The state has the longest coastline in India.
summary: Lothal is located in Gujarat.

title: 428. Which Harappan site is known for its sophisticated water conservation system?
hint: Located in the Rann of Kutch region.
summary: Dholavira is renowned for its advanced water management and reservoir system.

title: 429. Which Harappan site yielded evidence of a large signboard with Indus script symbols?
hint: It is one of the most important sites in Gujarat.
summary: A large signboard with Indus script symbols was discovered at Dholavira.

title: 678. The Hindu Kush Mountains are spread mainly across:
hint: Think Afghanistan.
summary: The Hindu Kush extends mainly through Afghanistan and northern Pakistan.

title: 679. The Kunlun Mountains are located primarily in:
hint: They lie north of the Tibetan Plateau.
summary: The Kunlun Mountains are located mainly in western China.

title: 680. The Altai Mountains are located at the junction of which four countries?
hint: Think Central and East Asia.
summary: The Altai Mountains meet at Russia, China, Mongolia and Kazakhstan.

title: 681. The Zagros Mountains are primarily located in which country?
hint: This country lies between Iraq and Pakistan.
summary: The Zagros Mountains extend mainly across western and southwestern Iran.
